description: This file defines an abstract class Zend_Validate_Abstract which serves as a base class for validation classes within the Zend Framework. It implements core validation message handling, translation support, and common validation functionalities.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Abstract
classes.description: An abstract base class providing core validation message handling, translator support, and validation state management for Zend Framework validators.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns an array of validation failure messages.

methods.name: getMessageVariables
methods.description: Returns the list of variable names used in validation messages.

methods.name: getMessageTemplates
methods.description: Returns the array of message templates.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a specific validation failure message for a message key.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets multiple validation failure messages at once.

methods.name: setTranslator
methods.description: Assigns a translation object to the validator.

methods.name: hasTranslator
methods.description: Checks if a specific translator has been set.

methods.name: setDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Sets the default translation object for all validators.

methods.name: getDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Retrieves the global default translation object.

methods.name: hasDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Checks if a default translator has been set.

methods.name: translatorIsDisabled
methods.description: Checks if translation is currently disabled.

methods.name: getMessageLength
methods.description: Gets the maximum length allowed for validation messages.

methods.name: setMessageLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum length allowed for validation messages.
